brief.message: Explain seed germination in the supplied order
brief.topic: Three needs of a germinating seed
brief.script: A seed needs three simple things to begin growing. First, moisture helps the seed take in water. Next, suitable warmth supports its early growth. Finally, air allows the living seed to breathe. The exact conditions depend on the plant. Check the instructions for your seed before you start. Keep the steps in that order and watch for the first small root.
